input.rationale: Article 12 contains a detailed exit architecture that runs in Harpoon's favour (Sections 12.6.1(c), 12.7 reversion, 12.10.2 sell-off), but nothing requires Harpoon to help us transition or to return our data on the way out. The only return mechanic is Section 9.7, which is request-based, limited to Confidential Information, triggered only on termination (not expiry), and requires delivery merely \"as soon as reasonably practicable\" with no outer date; Section 12.5.2 is bankruptcy-specific and the Section 3.8.5 / 4.5.2 transfers operate during the Term, not post-termination. No usable transition/data-export clause therefore exists. We insert the shortest fallback-level clause: 90 days of transition assistance on expiry or termination and export of our data within 30 days. We do not pursue the preferred then-current-rates, machine-readable format and certified-deletion elements, and we leave the existing Harpoon-favouring reversion mechanics untouched.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 12.11 requiring Harpoon to provide 90 days of post-termination transition assistance and to export AbbVie's data within 30 days.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 12 gives Harpoon its reversion package but gives us no exit support, and Section 9.7 only requires return of Confidential Information "as soon as reasonably practicable" on request. We have added a short exit clause at our fallback position: 90 days of transition assistance on expiry or termination and export of our data within 30 days.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Harpoon shall (a) provide AbbVie with reasonable transition assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following the effective date of such expiration or termination, and (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to AbbVie all data and Information belonging to, supplied by, or generated for AbbVie that is in Harpoon's possession or Control.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
